Findings from a study by Mahatma Gandhi Medical College doctors have sparked further scrutiny into the circumstances surrounding these cases.
title: Indore contaminated water crisis: A fortnight later, govt admits 15 deaths

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: "They definitely make plans. Now that they're playing only one format, they want India to win everywhere when they are there," Kotak said on the eve of India’s second ODI against New Zealand.
title: Kohli, Rohit discuss '27 ODI WC plans with Gambhir? Batting coach reveals details

author: MAHIMA ROY
description: George Kittle's wife, Claire Kittle, has always been spotted cheering on her husband and being there for him through all the tough times. While fans panic over George Kittle's absence from the field in the upcoming matches due to his brutal injury, the star player has shared a heartbreaking update about his injury. His wife, Claire Kittle's response to it has moved fans.
title: 'My superhero': Claire Kittle stands by George after injury update

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
title: NEET-PG cut-off score now fixed at -40 out of 800

author: ASMITA DEY
description: In a bid to prioritize safety for delivery partners, government officials are advocating for quick commerce companies to abandon their '10-minute' delivery claims. Notably, Blinkit and Instamart have already taken a step in this direction, and more companies are expected to follow suit. This initiative seeks to enhance working conditions for gig workers while maintaining flexible delivery timeframes.
title: On govt nudge, quick commerce firms dropping 10-min promise; what experts have to say

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Pakistan players endured further embarrassment in the Big Bash League as Hasan Ali’s misfield gifted a boundary during Adelaide Strikers’ loss to Melbourne Stars, just a day after Mohammad Rizwan became the first overseas player to be retired out. Tom Curran’s career-best spell then helped the Stars bowl Strikers out for 83 and seal an easy win.
title: Pakistan’s embarrassment in BBL: After Rizwan retired out, Ali also errs – Watch

author: SUMATI YENGKHOM
description: In Bengal, two nurses have tested positive for the Nipah virus and are currently in critical condition. One individual close to them has shown mild fever symptoms. Over 120 potential contacts are now under home isolation, as health officials continue their tracing efforts.
title: Pune lab confirms Nipah in 2 samples, both nurses critical

author: SURENDRA SINGH
description: The Indian Army is prepared to integrate women into infantry roles, contingent on societal readiness, Army Chief General Upendra Dwivedi stated. He emphasized gender neutrality and uniform standards, noting a sequential induction into combat roles. The Army is also undergoing significant modernization, focusing on drone capabilities, advanced weaponry, and self-reliance in ammunition for future warfare.
title: 'Ready to induct women in infantry if there is societal acceptance': Army chief

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Prabhas's 'Raja Saab' is facing a significant box office downturn, with collections plummeting after its initial days. Day 5 saw a meager Rs 4.85 crore, bringing the total to Rs 119.45 crore. Low occupancy across languages and overwhelmingly negative audience reviews citing poor storytelling and performances are contributing to the film's struggle, despite its star-studded cast.
title: 'The Raja Saab' Box Office collection day 5: Prabhas film slows down further
